entries.speaker: Tsuda
entries.en: ...So, you know everything?

entries.speaker: Tsuda
entries.en: Wait, that's the brat from your[n]shop, isn't it? I should've known[n]he was working for you!
entries.uk: Стривай, це ж той шмаркач із твоєї[n]крамниці? Так і знав, що він[n]на тебе працює!

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: He's here as my witness today.
entries.uk: Сьогодні він тут як мій свідок.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Now listen. I'd be glad to keep my[n]mouth shut about your failed deal...[n]if you stay away from my family.
entries.uk: А тепер слухайте. Я радо триматиму[n]язик за зубами про вашу провалену[n]угоду... якщо ви не чіпатимете мою сім'ю.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: That includes me, Kaoru...[n]and this kid here.
entries.uk: Це стосується мене, Каору...[n]і цього малого.

entries.speaker: Tsuda
entries.en: Hmph. So you're still sticking[n]to the code, even in retirement.
entries.uk: Хм. То ти й на пенсії[n]тримаєшся кодексу.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Rules ain't meant to be broken.
entries.uk: Правила не для того, щоб їх порушувати.

entries.speaker: Tsuda
entries.en: Heh, you're as sharp as ever,[n]Mune. Glad to see you haven't[n]lost your touch in your absence.
entries.uk: Хех, ти гострий, як і раніше,[n]Муне. Радий бачити, що ти[n]не втратив хватки.

entries.speaker: Tsuda
entries.en: I bet we never would've gotten duped[n]by those Hong Kong motherfuckers if I[n]still had you as my right-hand man.
entries.uk: Б'юся об заклад, нас би ніколи не обвели[n]круг пальця ті гонконзькі виродки,[n]якби ти досі був моєю правою рукою.

entries.speaker: Tsuda
entries.en: Instead I'm stuck dealing with the[n]mess that idiot Masa made for me...
entries.uk: А так я мушу розгрібати безлад,[n]який устиг наробити той бовдур Маса...

entries.speaker: Tsuda
entries.en: Hey, kid. Sorry for getting a[n]respectable teen like yourself[n]wrapped up in our bullshit feud.
entries.uk: Гей, малий. Вибач, що такого[n]порядного підлітка, як ти, втягнули[n]в нашу дурну ворожнечу.

entries.speaker: Tsuda
entries.en: I hope dealing with all this yakuza[n]business hasn't been too much trouble.
entries.uk: Сподіваюся, усі ці справи якудза[n]не завдали тобі надто багато клопоту.

entries.en: It most definitely was.
I did it all for Iwai.[clr 27]
Actually, it's been fun.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Heh. You didn't hafta[n]come out and say it...
entries.uk: Хех. Не обов'язково було[n]це вголос казати...

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: *chuckle* Thanks, kid.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Hey, don't antagonize him...

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Tsuda-san, I gotta be honest with[n]you... This whole thing has been[n]a real goddamn pain in the ass.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: But it's over. You're finished.

entries.speaker: Tsuda
entries.en: I don't think you understand, Mune...

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: What...!?

entries.speaker: Tsuda
entries.en: You're not the one who gets to[n]make the decisions around here!

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: The hell're you doin'...!?

entries.speaker: Tsuda
entries.en: I'm done playing nice with you.[n]You're gonna make me what I need[n]one way or another, Iwai!

entries.speaker: Tsuda
entries.en: And if you can't do it fast, both[n]your son and this little "witness"[n]of yours are gonna pay for it!

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Christ, Tsuda! You're not some[n]random thug off the street! You're[n]s'posed to be better than this...!

entries.speaker: Tsuda
entries.en: Times have changed, Mune. You're[n]hung up on bullshit like pride and[n]duty, but you know what?

entries.speaker: Tsuda
entries.en: Nobody gives a fuck about your[n]goddamn code of honor anymore!

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: You bastard...!

entries.speaker: Tsuda
entries.en: Now you listen to me, you[n]little piece of shit.

entries.speaker: Tsuda
entries.en: You're going to make me those guns,[n]and you're going to do it fast.

entries.speaker: Tsuda
entries.en: Don't make me tell you again.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: I'm such a freakin' idiot... That[n]guy ain't the Tsuda I know...!

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Based on what just happened here,[n]I'm done for the second I give[n]him the guns he's lookin' for.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Goddammit...

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: ...Look, kid. You should prolly go.[n]I don't got any more tasks for you.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Just forget all of this...
I will.[clr 27]
I want to help you.[clr 27]
I can't.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Good. This ain't nothin' a[n]kid like you can handle.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: I appreciate the offer, I really[n]do. I just... can't let you do that.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Well you damn sure[n]better figure out how.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: I... I'm gonna make those guns for him.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: I gotta do what I can to protect[n]Kaoru... If it means helpin' out[n]that psychopath, so be it...
It seems like Iwai's been[n]painted into a corner...
He might end up dead if I don't[n]do something about Tsuda soon...

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Tsuda... When did he turn into[n]such a heartless bastard...?
uk
